description: Joint Research Centre: wildfire hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Joint Research Centre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Joint Research Centre. Coverage: Joint Research Centre. The listing groups 206 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wildfire hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Wildfire in Central Spain (2026-07-20); Wildfire in Caceres, Spain (2023-05-17); Wildfire in Brandenburg,Deutschland (2022-06-20); Wildfires in West Spain (2025-08-15). Formats seen: ZIP, SHP, GDB, HTML, TIFF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, European Commission reuse notice, as linked on the portal listing (http://data.jrc.ec.europa.eu/licence/not_available). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-jrc.
